item.title: Shadow Trader Digest – 11 October 2026
item.description:
🕵️ Shadow Trader Digest – 11 October 2026


Three under-the-radar events that might quietly move markets this week:



  1. 🇺🇸 Columbus Day — NYSE open, US bond market closed
    Monday, 12 October · New York Stock Exchange
    Columbus Day is not an NYSE holiday, so US equities trade a normal session. SIFMA recommends a full close for US dollar fixed-income trading, and Federal Reserve banks are closed for the federal holiday.
    Source →

  2. 🇩🇪 Xetra auction calibration — maintenance
    Saturday, 17 October · Deutsche Börse
    Weekend maintenance; opening-auction parameters re-baselined ahead of the Q4 calendar.
    Source →

  3. 🇯🇵 Market holiday — Sports Day
    Monday, 12 October · JPX / TSE
    JPX / TSE closed for Sports Day. Settlement and expiry cycles roll to the next session.
    Source →


Stay hidden. Stay ahead.
— Goldirham Whisper
